'''Spaceport THX1138''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that was used as a starliner terminal by travel agencies that were members of the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]], including [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]].<ref name="STTAC" /> It was located in the [[Earth system]], within the [[Fath sector/Legends|Fath sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Description==
The space station had three large docking areas, or wings, around a central superstructure, plus two other struts.<ref name="STTAC" /> It was similar in design to a [[Valor (space station)/Legends|star base]] that operated earlier, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="I138">{{InsiderCite|138|Launchpad|Launch Pad}}</ref> Its billboards, advertisements, map displays, and arrival/departure screens displayed information in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]], and another written script.

===Sections===
[[File:Star_Tours_Tokyo_entrance_area.png|thumb|right|250px|Video screen in Central Hall]]
*'''Central Hall''', including Levels A through D, included a large video screen that displayed advertising and information about the spaceport and its travel agencies. It also displayed Imperial recruiting messages and listed some of the Empire's most-wanted criminals.<ref name="TDLVideo">{{YouTube|video=VP1Ms45_fZ8|text=TDL : New STAR TOURS【Space Port 1138】|channel=@couperin9|name=couperin9}}</ref>
**'''Level A''': The overall area of the baggage claim included entryways to the North and South Wings, a lift-tube access point, an overflow claim, and stops from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].
**'''Level B''': The [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] Claim, containing a PA Droid Scanning area, a sales market for restraining bolts, a booth for removing [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolts]], a droid assembly area, a droid repair area, a droid registration area, and a collection area.
**'''Level C''': Including the Duty Free area, souvenir shops for Outer Rim&ndash;related merchandise, several [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorders]], some [[RWH Droid Surplus]] stores, some [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] surplus stores, and [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]]. On the same level was the droid customs, which contained a certification station, a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory-wipe]] station, a memory backup station, Inspection Scan #1, and a droid registry for certification area.
**'''Level D''': Containing the baby center and clinic; there were incubation pods for infants, a doctor's station, a section for aquatic newborns, a section for personal assistance droids, a section for medical/surgical droids, and bacta tanks.

*'''North Wing''', housing the [[Bespin Direct]] and [[Dantooine Express]] terminals

*'''South Wing''', housing the [[Air Alderaan]], [[Tatooine Transit]] and [[Naboo Spacelines]] terminals

[[File:Star_Tours_2_queue_StarSpeeder_1000.jpg|thumb|right|250px|C-3PO and R2-D2 repairing a StarSpeeder 1000]]
*'''X Wing''', housing the Star Tours travel agency terminal. The main terminal area through which passengers passed to board flights included a large viewscreen displaying flight information and advertisements, and had room to house and repair a [[StarSpeeder 1000]]. The flight information was color-coded to indicate the destination of the flight: Arrivals were red and departures blue. Ramps from the terminal led to security and boarding areas, all of which commonly had droids and other equipment stored in plain view of passengers. The station also included the [[Lightspeed Lounge]] and an observation deck.<ref name="ST2-EE">{{EndorExpress|url=star-wars-adventures/star-tours-2/2011/06/star-tours-the-adventures-continue-june-3-2011|text=Star Tours: The Adventures Continue}}</ref> Signage in the station was usually displayed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic]] and in an unidentified Imperial script. Prior to each departure, the [[WA-7 waitress droid/Legends|WA-7 service droid]] [[Aly San San/Legends|Aly San San]] frequently made a public service announcement, with the designated StarSpeeder 1000 being brought up via cargo elevator to the departure area. The boarding gates also came in numeric and letter variants, the latter going from A to D. The starport also featured a [[Restricted Customs Area]].
**'''Level 1''': Baggage Claim / Transport
**'''Level 2''': Ticketing
**'''Level 3''': Security
**'''Level 4''': Boarding Gates (at least six of them)<ref name="Tokyo">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{C|Tokyo}}</ref>
**'''Level 5''': Lightspeed Lounge
**'''Level 6''': Observation Deck
[[File:Spaceport_THX1138_boarding_gates.jpg|thumb|250px|Star Tours-operated boarding gates at the spaceport, on Level 4]]
*'''Other section''': This section, located west from the X Wing, and immediately next to the west side of the North Wing, contained levels A, B, C, F, and G. These sections contained the [[Outer Rim Restaurant and Lounge]], the air-to-ground transportation section, the Muunilinst Credit Exchange for exchanging currency with various planets, the [[Stargazer Grill Restaurant]], and [[the Nebula Trillion Parsec Club]] for spacers. The air-to-ground transportation section required public transportation to get to the surface, and made use of ships such as [[Small passenger ship|SSP freighters]], [[line-operated shuttle]]s, independent star cruisers, personal shuttles, and [[CEC-class transport]]s. The currencies that could be exchanged at the Muunilinst Credit Exchange included [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic credits]], [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Imperial credits]], [[Adumari credcoin]]s, [[Aurodium/Legends|Aurodium]] coins, [[Corellian credit]]s, and [[Credit voucher|Credit Vouchers]].<ref name="STTAC" />

==History==
Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Star Tours travel agency opened their own terminal on the space station. Shortly after, a StarSpeeder 1000 filled with passengers accidentally began to take off without [[AC-38/Legends|the pilot droid]], leaving the vessel "captained" by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in the [[Astromech socket/Legends|astromech socket]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|detained the ship]] to arrest a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]] that was among passengers onboard. But Artoo instead took off out of the hangar, engaged in a firefight with the Imperials, then escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The droids would eventually deliver the spy to their planned destination.<ref name="STTAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Star_Tours_space_station.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Seen from its cockpit, a Star Tours [[StarSpeeder 1000]] escapes [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] coming from the station.]]
This station has a similar interior structure to the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction's [[Tomorrowland Starport]], since the later ride was a renovated version of the first. The queue and loading area of the ride are within the spaceport, and the exterior of it can be seen on the large video screen inside the queue. Both interior and exterior views can be seen in the ride's simulator screen.<ref name="STTAC" />

The space station was unnamed in the [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]] and [[Disneyland]] versions of the ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' ride, but the ride's queue in [[Tokyo Disneyland]] later included a video billboard which named the station and provided additional details,<ref name="TDLVideo" /> which was further confirmed for English-speaking audiences with the release of the [[StarWars.com]] blog entry ''[[Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours]]''.<ref name="Convenient">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> The name is yet another ''Star Wars'' reference to [[George Lucas]]' film [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|''THX 1138'']]. The design of [[Valor (space station)/Legends|space station Valor]], as seen in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode [[Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)|"Point of No Return"]], was based on this station by concept artist [[Pat Presley]].<ref name="I138" />

===Legends scenes===
[[File:Spaceport_THX1138_hangar.jpg|250px|thumb|One of the spaceport's hangars]]
Depending on which scenario is randomly chosen for the ride, the scene regarding the Imperials' discovery of a spy stowed on board the ST-1401 will have one of two outcomes. In one, several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] attack the vessel while [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], himself in a run-in with several stormtroopers, aids the shuttle in escaping, also attacking a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] when they exit the station. In the second, the ship is stopped midflight by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], only to be let go when [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] uses its onboard cannons to blast at Vader, who then sends a squadron of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] after it into space.<ref name="STTAC" />

===Non-canon scenes===
Beginning in [[2015]] alternate scenes featuring elements from the [[Sequel trilogy]] films and later [[Canon]] television series have been regularly added to the ride. Since the original ride is considered to be part of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, these later scenarios are non-canon. In one opening scene on the space station, it is [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] and agents of the [[First Order]] that detain the ship and its [[Resistance]] spy, while in another it's detained by a scanning droid and First Order [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] with [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], [[BB-8]], and the ''Falcon'' involved. In another scene set back in the time of the Rebellion, it is [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s [[T-6 1974]] ship that flees from Imperial forces with the StarSpeeder. In that scenario, the StarSpeeder returns to the Spaceport THX 1138 hangar at the end of the ride and is met by an angry AC-38.<ref name="STTAC" />
